summary: Plaintiffs raised fees in their opening term sheets, and fee amounts were negotiated throughout before the final class fund was agreed. Whitcombe Reyes’s private reasoning considered its own time and expenses when deciding its counterproposal, but the transcript does not clearly show counsel trading class relief for higher fees. Defense privately compared the competing class counsel and accepted Whitcombe Reyes’s lower total outlay, supporting reverse-auction tactics, but the declaration accurately described the fee-negotiation sequence.
